title: Proof of Usage discovery document
description: Published at the root of a work as proof-of-usage.json, and by a site at /.well-known/proof-of-usage.json. It says where records go and what the asking rests on.

work.description: Canonical URL of the work. This exact string is the fourth field of the hash, so it is declared rather than guessed.

path.description: Where the record file lives within the work.

branch.description: Branch the record file lives on, and the base of a pull request. Omit if it is the default branch.

format.description: markdown: one table row per record. jsonl: one object per line.

transports.description: How a record can be delivered. Absent, the pull request transport is assumed.

url.description: Required for the endpoint transport: where a record is POSTed.

contact.description: Where a question about this work's records is sent.

basis.description: What the asking rests on. request: a NOTICE, and refusing it breaches nothing. licence: a term of the licence the work is under.

record.title: A single usage record
record.description: One line of a jsonl record file, or one row of a markdown one.

date.description: ISO 8601 with a timezone. This exact string is the third field of the hash.

contact.description: Email address or URL. Deliberately outside the hash input.
